verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing runs several configurable automations in the background without manual action. It can automatically retry failed payments and send reminders on overdue invoices, auto-charge payment methods on file, and handle cash reconciliation. Webhooks and the API let developers build their own automated flows on top. These are fixed billing rules rather than a general, user-defined automation builder or agent-driven autonomous workflows, and custom automation requires writing code. Missing for 10: a no-code custom automation or workflow builder, agent-driven autonomous task execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliably the automations run.
